data.description:
🍬🍫 CANDY & CHOCOLATE KEYBOARD EVENTS STARTS EVERY 1 HOUR AND LASTS FOR 15M

Welcome to Become a Brainrot!

✨Upgrade your Rarity for Better Luck!

😴 YOUR BRAINROTS EARN CASH OFFLINE! 

🔥JOIN THE GROUP FOR FREE EPIC BRAINROT!!!
